routes.label: Count subsets and exclude the full set

question: How many proper subsets does a set with 4 elements have?
solution: There are 16 subsets. Each of the four elements can be included or omitted, and the \(2\times2\times2\times2=16\) resulting choice patterns give every subset exactly once. Excluding the set itself leaves 15 proper subsets.
